title.zh: 循环器病：调节心脏神经、强心利尿与灸补血
title.en: Circulatory Diseases: Regulating the Cardiac Nerves, Strengthening the Heart, Moxa for Anaemia

summary.zh: 心脏病他以“反射诱导”作用于心脏的副交感神经，目的是镇静、加强心力、促进心肌功能与利尿，取风池、大杼、肩井、心俞等颈背穴配内关、大陵，多用细针轻刺激或皮肤针，“不必按症立法，只需耐心久治”；急性心内膜炎、心肌炎以药为主、针作辅助；血液病重在灸(关元、足三里、脾俞、膈俞)促进营养吸收。预后写得审慎。
summary.en: For heart disease he works by reflex and induction on the cardiac parasympathetic to calm, strengthen the heart, restore myocardial function and promote diuresis, using neck-and-back points (Fengchi, Dazhu, Jianjing, Xinshu) with Neiguan and Daling, fine needles with light stimulation or the skin needle, treating patiently rather than by symptom. Acute endocarditis and myocarditis are drug-led with needling as adjunct; blood diseases rest on moxa (Guanyuan, Zusanli, Pishu, Geshu) to aid nutrition. Prognosis is stated cautiously.

takeaways.zh: 心脏病的目的是调节神经、强心，而不是治“病名”：狭心症用反射诱导传达心脏副交感神经以镇静缓解，神经性心悸亢进“反射的兴奋副交感神经心脏支”，脂肪心“以加强心力为目的”；心脏瓣膜症则“概以促进心肌功能之回复与利尿为目的。不必按症立法，只需耐心久治”。
takeaways.en: For the heart the aim is regulating nerves and strengthening, not treating a disease name: angina by reflex and induction to the cardiac parasympathetic to calm; nervous palpitation by reflexly exciting the parasympathetic cardiac branch; fatty heart to strengthen the heart; valvular disease to restore myocardial function and promote diuresis, "no need to set a method by symptom, only patient long treatment".

takeaways.zh: 取穴的骨架是“颈项肩背+心俞+前臂”：风池在11条中7条，大杼、心俞各6条，肩井、天柱各5条；前臂取内关、大陵、侠白，腹部取中脘、气海、关元，下肢取足三里、三阴交。慢性者常成两组穴，每日轮换。
takeaways.en: The skeleton is neck-shoulder-back plus Xinshu plus the forearm: Fengchi in 7 of 11 entries, Dazhu and Xinshu in 6 each, Jianjing and Tianzhu in 5; forearm Neiguan, Daling, Xiabai; abdomen Zhongwan, Qihai, Guanyuan; leg Zusanli, Sanyinjiao. Chronic entries give two point groups used in daily rotation.

takeaways.zh: 刺激宜轻、宜久：心绞痛用28号针轻刺激，发作时取侠白、孔最、内关“作轻刺激久留，待心绞痛缓解后出针”；心瓣膜症用30号针“轻针”以加强心功能，有浮肿时才改中等度刺激以旺盛利尿。皮肤针见于心绞痛、心瓣膜症、脂肪心与贫血4条；心绞痛沿颈项两侧、肩上及前臂内侧捶击，“以距离半寸击3下为定则”。
takeaways.en: Stimulation is light and long: angina uses a No. 28 needle lightly, at an attack Xiabai, Kongzui, Neiguan "retained long with light stimulation, withdrawn once the pain eases"; valvular disease uses a No. 30 needle lightly to strengthen the heart, moving to moderate stimulation only for oedema to drive diuresis. The skin needle appears in four entries (angina, valvular disease, fatty heart, anaemia); in angina it runs along the neck, shoulder top and inner forearm, "3 taps every half cun".

takeaways.zh: 急性心脏炎症以药物为主：急性心内膜炎“应以药物作主治，由专医治疗”，针作诱导辅助，用28号针强刺激；急性心肌炎“应由专医治疗，针术作助治”。同一病在他的病理篇里更严格——急性心内膜炎与动脉瘤明写“本症不适用针灸治疗”，两书说法不完全一致。
takeaways.en: Acute cardiac inflammation is drug-led: acute endocarditis is a specialist's drug case with needling as induction adjunct (No. 28, strong); acute myocarditis likewise. His pathology book is stricter: acute endocarditis and aneurysm are plainly "not suited to acupuncture", so the two books do not fully agree.

takeaways.zh: 两书对心绞痛的刺激强度也说法不一：处方集用轻刺激久留，病理篇写“行强刺激，以镇静为主目的”。忠实的读法是两说并存：都以镇静为目的，取侠白、孔最(内关)，强度未统一。
takeaways.en: The two books also differ on stimulation strength in angina: the prescription book says light and retained, the pathology book "strong stimulation, calming as the main aim". Both share the aim (calming) and the points Xiabai and Kongzui; the strength is not reconciled.

takeaways.zh: 血管与血液病走另一条路：动脉硬化以“调整全身之血行，降低其血压”为目的，针灸并用——八穴“各灸小炷七壮，连灸3日”；贫血、萎黄病、白血病三条全用灸，目的分别是促进营养吸收、旺盛血行、强壮，取关元、足三里、脾俞、膈俞、三焦俞。贫血还要“原因疗法与对症疗法，相互施治”。
takeaways.en: Vessels and blood take another route: arteriosclerosis aims to regulate whole-body circulation and lower blood pressure, needle plus moxa (eight points, small cones of seven, three days running); anaemia, chlorosis and leukaemia all use moxa, aimed at nutrient absorption, circulation and strengthening, at Guanyuan, Zusanli, Pishu, Geshu, Sanjiaoshu. Anaemia also needs cause treatment and symptomatic treatment together.

takeaways.zh: 预后审慎，不作承诺：心脏瓣膜症“无特效疗法，如调养得法，亦可延年”；急性心肌炎“往往治愈之后，复突然死亡者有之”；心绞痛反复频发有在发作中死亡之虞；动脉硬化“易发脑溢血，多危险性”。仅神经性心悸亢进标“良”，萎黄病“得全治者多”。
takeaways.en: Prognosis is cautious and makes no promises: valvular disease has no specific cure but good care can prolong life; after apparent recovery from myocarditis sudden death may occur; frequent angina risks death in an attack; arteriosclerosis readily leads to cerebral haemorrhage. Only nervous palpitation is marked good and chlorosis mostly curable.

caveats.zh: 病名为民国时期西医名词(心脏痉挛、心脏瓣膜症、脂肪心、萎黄病等)，“副交感神经”“诱导”是他当时的解释框架。处方集与病理篇在急性心内膜炎(前者作辅助、后者不适用)和心绞痛刺激强度(前者轻刺激久留、后者强刺激)上不完全一致，本文两说并存。血液病(白血病等)在他笔下只是促进营养、强壮的对症调理，不可视为针灸治愈的主张。
caveats.en: Disease names are Republican-era Western terms (cardiac spasm, valvular disease, fatty heart, chlorosis), and "parasympathetic" and "induction" are his framework of the day. The prescription and pathology books differ on acute endocarditis (adjunct vs not suited) and on angina stimulation (light and retained vs strong); both are reported. For blood diseases such as leukaemia his text offers supportive nutritional strengthening only, not a claim of cure.
